## Load Libraries

```{r}
library(rnassqs)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tidyverse)
library(stringr)
library(scales)
```

## Function built from cropScript
# Swap out years to batch download all layers

```{r}
# Define the function
get_top_crop_per_county <- function(year_choice, state_choice = "NC", api_key) {
  
  # Load the API key
  nassqs_auth(api_key)

  # Define parameters
  paramsAcresHarvested <- list(
    year = year_choice,
    state_alpha = state_choice,
    agg_level_desc = "COUNTY",
    statisticcat_desc = "AREA HARVESTED"
  )
  
  # Make the query
  nc_crops_acresharvested_data <- nassqs(paramsAcresHarvested)
  
  # Clean up the data
  nc_crops_acresharvested_clean <- nc_crops_acresharvested_data |>
    select(year, county_name, statisticcat_desc, commodity_desc, unit_desc, Value) |>
    arrange(year, county_name, statisticcat_desc, commodity_desc, unit_desc, Value)
  
  # Clean column names and keep Value as numeric
  nc_crops_acresharvested_clean_names <- nc_crops_acresharvested_clean |>
    mutate(
      Year = year,
      County = str_to_title(county_name),
      Crop = str_to_title(commodity_desc),
      Statistic = str_to_title(statisticcat_desc),
      Unit = str_to_title(unit_desc),
      Value = as.numeric(gsub(",", "", Value))  # convert to raw numeric
    )
  
  # Select relevant columns
  nc_crops_selected_acresharvested <- nc_crops_acresharvested_clean_names |>
    select(Year, County, Crop, Unit, Value)
  
  # Filter out unwanted counties and remove duplicates
  nc_acresharvested_filtered <- nc_crops_selected_acresharvested |>
    filter(County != "Other (Combined) Counties") |>
    distinct(Year, County, Crop, Unit, Value, .keep_all = TRUE)
  
  # Sum values for multiple reports per county/crop
  nc_acresharvested_summarised <- nc_acresharvested_filtered |>
    group_by(Year, County, Crop, Unit) |>
    summarise(Value = sum(Value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  
  # Group by County, Crop, and Value again to ensure clean aggregation
  county_top_crop <- nc_acresharvested_summarised |>
    group_by(Year, County, Crop, Unit, Value) |>
    summarise(Value = sum(Value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  
  # Select top crop per county
  top_crop_per_county <- county_top_crop |>
    group_by(County) |>
    slice_max(order_by = Value, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
    ungroup()
  
  # View result
  print(top_crop_per_county)
  
  # Save to CSV
  output_filename <- paste0("top_crop_per_county_acresharvested_", year_choice, ".csv")
  write_csv(top_crop_per_county, output_filename)
  
  # Message
  cat("Data saved to '", output_filename, "'\n", sep = "")
  
  # Return the result
  return(top_crop_per_county)
}

# Example usage:
my_api_key <- "9E6A687A-B7F5-3950-B4BA-8511C501D06B"
top_crop_2022 <- get_top_crop_per_county(year_choice = "2022", state_choice = "NC", api_key = my_api_key)
```
